<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>Sparkwell Science Museum for Kids | Where Curious Minds Explore</title>
  <meta name="description" content="Hands-on science galleries, live shows, and experiments designed for curious kids ages 2 to 12.">
  <style>
    /* ============================================
       DESIGN TOKENS
       ============================================ */
    :root {
      --navy: #1c1f4a;
      --navy-deep: #12143a;
      --ink: #1d2140;
      --muted: #5c6184;
      --cream: #fff9ec;
      --white: #ffffff;
      --sun: #ffd23f;
      --coral: #ff6b6b;
      --mint: #3ddc97;
      --sky: #4cc9f0;
      --violet: #9d6bff;
      --orange: #ff9f1c;
      --radius: 24px;
      --radius-sm: 14px;
      --shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(18, 20, 58, 0.15);
      --font-display: "Trebuchet MS", "Avenir Next", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif;
      --font-body: "Segoe UI", system-ui, -apple-system, Roboto, sans-serif;
    }

    /* ============================================
       BASE
       ============================================ */
    *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }
    html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }
    body {
      margin: 0;
      font-family: var(--font-body);
      color: var(--ink);
      background: var(--cream);
      line-height: 1.6;
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
    }
    h1, h2, h3, h4 {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      line-height: 1.15;
      margin: 0 0 0.5em;
      color: var(--navy);
    }
    p { margin: 0 0 1em; }
    a { color: inherit; }
    img, svg { display: block; max-width: 100%; }
    .container { width: min(1180px, 92%); margin: 0 auto; }
    section { padding: clamp(64px, 9vw, 110px) 0; position: relative; }
    .section-label {
      display: inline-block;
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      letter-spacing: 0.12em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--coral);
      background: rgba(255, 107, 107, 0.12);
      padding: 6px 14px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
    }
    .section-title { font-size: clamp(2rem, 4.5vw, 3rem); margin-bottom: 14px; }
    .section-intro { color: var(--muted); font-size: 1.1rem; max-width: 640px; }
    .section-head { text-align: center; margin-bottom: 52px; }
    .section-head .section-intro { margin: 0 auto; }

    /* Buttons */
    .btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 1.05rem;
      padding: 14px 28px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      border: 3px solid transparent;
      text-decoration: none;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: transform 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease, background 0.2s ease;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .btn:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); }
    .btn:focus-visible, a:focus-visible, button:focus-visible, input:focus-visible, summary:focus-visible {
      outline: 3px solid var(--sky);
      outline-offset: 3px;
    }
    .btn-primary {
      background: var(--sun);
      color: var(--navy);
      box-shadow: 0 6px 0 #e0b000;
    }
    .btn-primary:hover { box-shadow: 0 9px 0 #e0b000; }
    .btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(3px); box-shadow: 0 2px 0 #e0b000; }
    .btn-ghost {
      background: transparent;
      color: var(--white);
      border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7);
    }
    .btn-ghost:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.12); }
    .btn-dark {
      background: var(--navy);
      color: var(--white);
      box-shadow: 0 6px 0 var(--navy-deep);
    }
    .btn-dark:hover { box-shadow: 0 9px 0 var(--navy-deep); }

    /* ============================================
       NAVIGATION
       ============================================ */
    .nav {
      position: sticky;
      top: 0;
      z-index: 100;
      background: rgba(28, 31, 74, 0.94);
      backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
    }
    .nav-inner {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      height: 76px;
    }
    .logo {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      text-decoration: none;
      color: var(--white);
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 1.35rem;
    }
    .logo span em { font-style: normal; color: var(--sun); }
    .nav-links {
      display: flex;
      gap: 28px;
      list-style: none;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
    }
    .nav-links a {
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.85);
      text-decoration: none;
      font-weight: 600;
      font-size: 0.98rem;
      transition: color 0.2s;
    }
    .nav-links a:hover { color: var(--sun); }
    .nav-cta { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; }
    .nav-cta .btn { padding: 10px 20px; font-size: 0.95rem; }
    .menu-toggle {
      display: none;
      background: none;
      border: 0;
      color: var(--white);
      font-size: 1.8rem;
      cursor: pointer;
      padding: 4px 8px;
    }

    /* ============================================
       HERO
       ============================================ */
    .hero {
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 15% 20%, rgba(76, 201, 240, 0.35), transparent 40%),
        radial-gradient(circle at 85% 30%, rgba(157, 107, 255, 0.35), transparent 42%),
        linear-gradient(160deg, var(--navy) 0%, var(--navy-deep) 100%);
      color: var(--white);
      padding: clamp(60px, 8vw, 100px) 0 clamp(90px, 10vw, 130px);
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .hero::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      left: 0; right: 0; bottom: -1px;
      height: 80px;
      background: var(--cream);
      clip-path: ellipse(60% 100% at 50% 100%);
    }
    .hero-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1.1fr 0.9fr;
      gap: 40px;
      align-items: center;
    }
    .hero-kicker {
      display: inline-block;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.12);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.25);
      padding: 6px 16px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      font-weight: 600;
      font-size: 0.92rem;
      margin-bottom: 22px;
    }
    .hero h1 {
      color: var(--white);
      font-size: clamp(2.6rem, 6vw, 4.4rem);
      line-height: 1.05;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
    }
    .hero h1 .highlight {
      color: var(--sun);
      position: relative;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .hero-lead {
      font-size: 1.18rem;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.85);
      max-width: 520px;
      margin-bottom: 32px;
    }
    .hero-actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 16px; margin-bottom: 40px; }
    .hero-stats {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 14px;
    }
    .stat {
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      padding: 14px 20px;
      min-width: 140px;
    }
    .stat strong {
      display: block;
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 1.7rem;
      color: var(--sun);
      line-height: 1.1;
    }
    .stat span { font-size: 0.9rem; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.8); }

    /* Hero illustration: orbiting planets built in SVG/CSS */
    .hero-art {
      position: relative;
      aspect-ratio: 1;
      width: min(480px, 100%);
      margin: 0 auto;
    }
    .orbit {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      border-radius: 50%;
      border: 2px dashed rgba(255,255,255,0.25);
      animation: spin 28s linear infinite;
    }
    .orbit.two { inset: 12%; animation-duration: 18s; animation-direction: reverse; border-color: rgba(76,201,240,0.4); }
    .orbit.three { inset: 25%; animation-duration: 12s; border-color: rgba(255,210,63,0.45); }
    .planet {
      position: absolute;
      border-radius: 50%;
      box-shadow: inset -12px -14px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.15), 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
    }
    .sun-core {
      position: absolute;
      left: 50%; top: 50%;
      width: 36%; aspect-ratio: 1;
      transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 35%, #fff6b0, var(--sun) 55%, var(--orange));
      box-shadow: 0 0 60px rgba(255, 210, 63, 0.7);
      animation: pulse 4s ease-in-out infinite;
    }
    .planet-a {
      width: 16%; aspect-ratio: 1; top: 2%; left: 50%;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      background: radial-gradient(circle at 30% 30%, #9ef0c8, var(--mint));
    }
    .planet-b {
      width: 11%; aspect-ratio: 1; top: 50%; right: 4%;
      transform: translateY(-50%);
      background: radial-gradient(circle at 30% 30%, #ffb3b3, var(--coral));
    }
    .planet-c {
      width: 8%; aspect-ratio: 1; bottom: 14%; left: 12%;
      background: radial-gradient(circle at 30% 30%, #c9b3ff, var(--violet));
    }
    .planet-d {
      width: 13%; aspect-ratio: 1; top: 18%; left: 8%;
      background: radial-gradient(circle at 30% 30%, #b8ecff, var(--sky));
    }
    .float-badge {
      position: absolute;
      background: var(--white);
      color: var(--navy);
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      padding: 10px 16px;
      border-radius: 16px;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow);
      animation: bob 5s ease-in-out infinite;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .float-badge.b1 { top: 6%; right: -2%; transform: rotate(4deg); }
    .float-badge.b2 { bottom: 8%; left: -4%; animation-delay: -2s; transform: rotate(-3deg); }

    @keyframes spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
    @keyframes pulse {
      0%, 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 50px rgba(255,210,63,0.6); }
      50% { box-shadow: 0 0 90px rgba(255,210,63,0.9); }
    }
    @keyframes bob {
      0%, 100% { translate: 0 0; }
      50% { translate: 0 -10px; }
    }

    /* ============================================
       ANNOUNCEMENT STRIP
       ============================================ */
    .ticker {
      background: var(--coral);
      color: var(--white);
      overflow: hidden;
      white-space: nowrap;
      padding: 14px 0;
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 1.05rem;
    }
    .ticker-track {
      display: inline-flex;
      gap: 48px;
      animation: marquee 30s linear infinite;
      padding-left: 48px;
    }
    .ticker-track span::after { content: "✦"; margin-left: 48px; opacity: 0.7; }
    @keyframes marquee {
      from { transform: translateX(0); }
      to { transform: translateX(-50%); }
    }

    /* ============================================
       EXHIBITS
       ============================================ */
    .exhibits-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(300px, 1fr));
      gap: 26px;
    }
    .exhibit-card {
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      overflow: hidden;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      transition: transform 0.25s ease;
    }
    .exhibit-card:hover { transform: translateY(-6px) rotate(-0.5deg); }
    .exhibit-visual {
      height: 170px;
      position: relative;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 4.5rem;
    }
    .exhibit-visual .emoji { filter: drop-shadow(0 8px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.2)); transition: transform 0.4s ease; }
    .exhibit-card:hover .emoji { transform: scale(1.12) rotate(-6deg); }
    .exhibit-body { padding: 26px 28px 30px; flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
    .exhibit-body h3 { font-size: 1.4rem; margin-bottom: 8px; }
    .exhibit-body p { color: var(--muted); margin-bottom: 18px; }
    .age-tag {
      margin-top: auto;
      align-self: flex-start;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      padding: 5px 12px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: var(--cream);
      color: var(--navy);
    }
    .bg-sky { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #a5e8ff, var(--sky)); }
    .bg-mint { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #c3ffe4, var(--mint)); }
    .bg-sun { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #fff3b0, var(--sun)); }
    .bg-coral { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ffd0d0, var(--coral)); }
    .bg-violet { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #e0d2ff, var(--violet)); }
    .bg-orange { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ffe0b8, var(--orange)); }

    /* ============================================
       FEATURE SPLIT (Planetarium / Lab)
       ============================================ */
    .split {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 60px;
      align-items: center;
    }
    .split.reverse .split-media { order: 2; }
    .split-media {
      border-radius: 32px;
      background: linear-gradient(145deg, var(--navy), #3b2e8c);
      aspect-ratio: 4 / 3;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
    }
    .split-media svg { width: 70%; height: auto; }
    .checklist { list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 24px 0 32px; }
    .checklist li {
      position: relative;
      padding-left: 38px;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
      font-weight: 500;
    }
    .checklist li::before {
      content: "★";
      position: absolute;
      left: 0; top: 0;
      width: 26px; height: 26px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--sun);
      color: var(--navy);
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
    }

    /* ============================================
       TODAY / SCHEDULE
       ============================================ */
    .schedule { background: var(--white); }
    .schedule-wrap {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.3fr;
      gap: 50px;
      align-items: start;
    }
    .schedule-list {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 14px;
    }
    .show {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 90px 1fr auto;
      gap: 18px;
      align-items: center;
      background: var(--cream);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      padding: 16px 20px;
      border-left: 6px solid var(--sky);
    }
    .show:nth-child(2) { border-color: var(--mint); }
    .show:nth-child(3) { border-color: var(--coral); }
    .show:nth-child(4) { border-color: var(--violet); }
    .show:nth-child(5) { border-color: var(--sun); }
    .show time {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--navy);
      font-size: 1.05rem;
    }
    .show h4 { margin: 0 0 2px; font-size: 1.1rem; }
    .show p { margin: 0; font-size: 0.92rem; color: var(--muted); }
    .show .seats { font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--navy); white-space: nowrap; }
    .show .seats.full { color: var(--coral); }

    .day-picker { display: flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 22px; }
    .day-picker button {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      padding: 10px 18px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      border: 2px solid var(--navy);
      background: transparent;
      color: var(--navy);
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.2s;
    }
    .day-picker button[aria-pressed="true"],
    .day-picker button:hover {
      background: var(--navy);
      color: var(--white);
    }
    .schedule-note {
      margin-top: 18px;
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      color: var(--muted);
    }

    /* ============================================
       TICKETS / VISIT
       ============================================ */
    .tickets-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(250px, 1fr));
      gap: 26px;
      align-items: stretch;
    }
    .ticket {
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      padding: 36px 30px;
      text-align: center;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      position: relative;
      border: 3px solid transparent;
    }
    .ticket.featured {
      background: var(--navy);
      color: var(--white);
      border-color: var(--sun);
      transform: scale(1.04);
    }
    .ticket.featured h3, .ticket.featured .price { color: var(--white); }
    .ticket.featured .price span { color: var(--sun); }
    .ticket.featured .ticket-list li { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.88); }
    .ticket-badge {
      position: absolute;
      top: -16px;
      left: 50%;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      background: var(--sun);
      color: var(--navy);
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      padding: 6px 14px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .ticket h3 { font-size: 1.5rem; margin-bottom: 6px; }
    .ticket .ages { color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.95rem; margin-bottom: 18px; }
    .ticket.featured .ages { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7); }
    .price {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 3rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--navy);
      line-height: 1;
      margin-bottom: 4px;
    }
    .price span { font-size: 1rem; color: var(--muted); font-weight: 600; }
    .ticket-list {
      list-style: none;
      padding: 0;
      margin: 22px 0 28px;
      text-align: left;
      flex: 1;
    }
    .ticket-list li {
      padding: 8px 0;
      border-bottom: 1px dashed rgba(92, 97, 132, 0.25);
      font-size: 0.97rem;
    }
    .ticket-list li::before { content: "✓ "; color: var(--mint); font-weight: 800; }
    .ticket.featured .ticket-list li::before { color: var(--sun); }
    .ticket .btn { justify-content: center; width: 100%; }

    .info-strip {
      margin-top: 60px;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(230px, 1fr));
      gap: 20px;
    }
    .info-card {
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      padding: 24px;
      box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(28,31,74,0.07);
    }
    .info-card .icon { font-size: 2rem; margin-bottom: 8px; }
    .info-card h4 { font-size: 1.1rem; margin-bottom: 8px; }
    .info-card p, .info-card li { color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.95rem; margin: 0; }
    .info-card ul { list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 0; }
    .info-card li { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; padding: 4px 0; }
    .info-card li strong { color: var(--navy); }

    /* ============================================
       TESTIMONIALS
       ============================================ */
    .testimonials { background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--cream), #ffeccc); }
    .quotes {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(270px, 1fr));
      gap: 24px;
    }
    .quote {
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      padding: 30px 28px;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow);
      position: relative;
    }
    .quote::before {
      content: "\201C";
      position: absolute;
      top: 6px; right: 22px;
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 5rem;
      color: rgba(255, 107, 107, 0.2);
      line-height: 1;
    }
    .quote blockquote { margin: 0 0 20px; font-size: 1.05rem; position: relative; }
    .quote-author { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; }
    .avatar {
      width: 48px; height: 48px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      font-size: 1.5rem;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .quote-author strong { display: block; color: var(--navy); }
    .quote-author span { font-size: 0.88rem; color: var(--muted); }
    .stars { color: var(--orange); letter-spacing: 2px; margin-bottom: 10px; }

    /* ============================================
       MEMBERSHIP BAND
       ============================================ */
    .membership {
      padding: 0;
    }
    .membership-inner {
      background: linear-gradient(120deg, var(--violet), var(--sky));
      border-radius: 32px;
      padding: clamp(36px, 6vw, 64px);
      color: var(--white);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 30px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .membership-inner::before, .membership-inner::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.12);
    }
    .membership-inner::before { width: 260px; height: 260px; top: -110px; right: -60px; }
    .membership-inner::after { width: 160px; height: 160px; bottom: -80px; left: 30%; }
    .membership-copy { max-width: 560px; position: relative; z-index: 1; }
    .membership-copy h2 { color: var(--white); font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 3.5vw, 2.5rem); }
    .membership-copy p { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.92); margin: 0; }
    .membership-inner .btn { position: relative; z-index: 1; }

    /* ============================================
       FAQ
       ============================================ */
    .faq-wrap {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 0.8fr 1.2fr;
      gap: 60px;
      align-items: start;
    }
    .faq details {
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      padding: 18px 22px;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
      box-shadow: 0 3px 12px rgba(28,31,74,0.06);
    }
    .faq summary {
      cursor: pointer;
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--navy);
      font-size: 1.05rem;
      list-style: none;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
    }
    .faq summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; }
    .faq summary::after {
      content: "+";
      font-size: 1.6rem;
      line-height: 1;

            <li><a href="#today">Today's Schedule</a></li>
            <li><a href="#tickets">Tickets</a></li>
            <li><a href="#visit">Hours & Location</a></li>
          </ul>
        </div>

        <div>
          <h4>Learn</h4>
          <ul>
            <li><a href="#">School Field Trips</a></li>
            <li><a href="#">Birthday Parties</a></li>
            <li><a href="#">Teacher Resources</a></li>
            <li><a href="#membership">Membership</a></li>
          </ul>
        </div>

        <div>
          <h4>Stay in the loop</h4>
          <p style="font-size:0.95rem;">Get weekly event picks and new exhibit news.</p>
          <form class="newsletter" id="newsletterForm" novalidate>
            <label for="email" class="sr-only" style="position:absolute;left:-9999px;">Email address</label>
            <input type="email" id="email" name="email" placeholder="you@example.com" required>
            <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary">Join</button>
          </form>
          <div class="form-msg" id="formMsg" role="status" aria-live="polite"></div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="footer-bottom">
        <span>© 2025 Sparkwell Science Museum for Kids. A registered 501(c)(3) nonprofit.</span>
        <span><a href="#">Privacy</a> · <a href="#">Accessibility</a> · <a href="#">Terms</a></span>
      </div>
    </div>
  </footer>

  <script>
    // Mobile navigation toggle
    const menuToggle = document.getElementById('menuToggle');
    const navLinks = document.getElementById('navLinks');
    menuToggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const isOpen = navLinks.classList.toggle('open');
      menuToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(isOpen));
      menuToggle.textContent = isOpen ? '✕' : '☰';
    });
    navLinks.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(link =>
      link.addEventListener('click', () => {
        navLinks.classList.remove('open');
        menuToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
        menuToggle.textContent = '☰';
      })
    );

    // Day picker for the schedule
    const schedules = {
      Today: [
        ['10:00', 'Bubble Bonanza', 'Bubble chemistry with Spark Guide Maya · Gallery 3', '12 spots'],
        ['11:30', 'Robot Parade', 'Meet the lab robots and watch them dance · Main Hall', 'Open'],
        ['13:00', 'Starlight Dome Show', 'Tour the solar system in 25 minutes · Dome Theater', 'Sold out'],
        ['14:30', 'Dino Dig Demo', 'Excavate like a paleontologist · Dino Dig Pit', '8 spots'],
        ['16:00', 'Weather Station Live', 'Build a rain gauge and predict tomorrow · Studio 5', 'Open'],
      ],
      Saturday: [
        ['09:30', 'Family Physics Fair', 'Hands-on forces and motion · Main Hall', 'Open'],
        ['11:00', 'Robot Parade', 'Meet the lab robots and watch them dance · Main Hall', '5 spots'],
        ['12:30', 'Starlight Dome Show', 'Journey through the Milky Way · Dome Theater', 'Open'],
        ['14:00', 'Rocket Countdown', 'Build and launch a foam rocket · Launch Lab', 'Open'],
        ['15:30', 'Glow Lab Sneak Peek', 'A taste of Thursday nights · Gallery 7', '2 spots'],
      ],
      Sunday: [
        ['10:00', 'Garden Explorers', 'Plant a seed and take it home · Tiny Garden Lab', 'Open'],
        ['11:30', 'Dino Dig Demo', 'Excavate like a paleontologist · Dino Dig Pit', 'Open'],
        ['13:00', 'Starlight Dome Show', 'Tour the solar system in 25 minutes · Dome Theater', 'Open'],
        ['14:30', 'Human Body Hour', 'Heartbeats, lungs, and reflexes · Body Adventure', '10 spots'],
        ['16:00', 'Weather Station Live', 'Build a rain gauge and predict tomorrow · Studio 5', 'Open'],
      ],
    };

    const scheduleList = document.getElementById('scheduleList');
    const dayButtons = document.querySelectorAll('.day-picker button');

    function renderSchedule(day) {
      scheduleList.innerHTML = '';
      schedules[day].forEach(([time, title, desc, seats]) => {
        const full = seats.toLowerCase() === 'sold out';
        const row = document.createElement('div');
        row.className = 'show';
        row.innerHTML = `
          <time>${time}</time>
          <div><h4></h4><p></p></div>
          <span class="seats ${full ? 'full' : ''}"></span>`;
        row.querySelector('h4').textContent = title;
        row.querySelector('p').textContent = desc;
        row.querySelector('.seats').textContent = seats;
        scheduleList.appendChild(row);
      });
    }

    dayButtons.forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        dayButtons.forEach(b => b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false'));
        btn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'true');
        renderSchedule(btn.dataset.day);
      });
    });

    // Newsletter form
    const form = document.getElementById('newsletterForm');
    const formMsg = document.getElementById('formMsg');
    form.addEventListener('submit', (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      const email = form.email.value.trim();
      const valid = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(email);
      if (!valid) {
        formMsg.style.color = 'var(--coral)';
        formMsg.textContent = 'Please enter a valid email address.';
        return;
      }
      formMsg.style.color = 'var(--mint)';
      formMsg.textContent = 'Welcome aboard! Your first science newsletter is on its way.';
      form.reset();
    });
  </script>
</body>
</html>
